details.analytic: rho=distance to frozen core rectangle / radius. rho<=1 is exactly the same rounded rectangle; no fitted silhouette change.

details.proof: Distance to convex core box is convex; rho^power convex for power>=3; h1 concave. h2 longitudinal quadratic concave. Shared harmonic_cap increasing concave, nonnegative weights summing<=1. Height bound at center; gradient bound max(power*depth/radius,2*crown_depth/majorhalf).
details.regularity: Actual height/gradient C1; second derivatives can jump at the frozen capsule/core-box joins. No false global C2 claim or independent normals.

details.scope: Same harmonic law and physical depths, true circle plus isotropic quadratic. Longitudinal pill profile is intentionally not falsely called rotationally symmetric.
